title: Arkansas Air National Guard supports Hurricane Harvey relief efforts
description: The 189th Airlift Wing at Little Rock Air Force Base, Ark. in partnership with the 142nd Fighter Wing located at Portland Air National Guard Base, Ore., provide support during the Hurricane Harvey relief effort. The 189th AW transported Airmen from the 125th Special Tactics Squadron and the 304th Rescue Squadron to provide aid to victims. The National Guard forces will continue to ready aircraft, equipment and troops , and prepare installation and armories, as appropriate in support of Hurricane Harvey relief efforts.

transcript.text: - The 189th airlift wing at Little Rock Air Force Base,
in conjunction with airmen from
the 125th special tactics squadron,
and the 304th rescue squadron,
departed the Portland International Guard Base yesterday
in support of Hurricane Harvey.
The international guard airmen
will be providing equipment and other supplies
to support the relief effort in the Gulf of Mexico region.
The members are working hand in hand
with Ellington Field Joint Reserve Base, Houston,
to coordinate their relief effort in response.
No other organization in the Department of Defense
has the combination of size, skills,
training and experience,
dispersion across the nation,
command and communications infrastructure
and the legal flexibility to support civil authorities
at a moment's notice.
The National Guard Forces will continue
to ready aircraft, equipment and troupes
and prepare installations and armories as appropriate.
Reporting from Little Rock Air Force Base,
I'm technical sergeant, Jessica Condit.
